tweets.text:
🛡️ PROTECTING OUR SHORES: Joint Operation Keeps 346KG of Cocaine Off Our Streets! 
 
A high-impact, joint monitoring operation has successfully prevented 346 kilograms of cocaine from reaching our communities!
 
Operating as a unified front, multiple law enforcement and maritime agencies tracked a suspicious "Go-Fast" vessel traveling across the Caribbean Sea from the U.S. Virgin Islands toward Puerto Rico. The vessel was intercepted at a boat ramp after being tracked 5 nautical miles east of Luquillo.
 
The operation resulted in the seizure of the illicit vessel, hundreds of vacuum-sealed drug packages, and the arrest of two smugglers.
 
This massive interdiction is a testament to the seamless collaboration of:
✅ Puerto Rico Police Department Marine Interdiction Unit (FURA)
✅ Puerto Rico Police Department FURA Intelligence Division
✅ Homeland Security Task Force (HSTF) San Juan
✅ U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) Air and Marine Operations
✅Joint Interagency Task Force South (JIATF-S)
 
Together, we remain resolute in our mission to disrupt drug trafficking networks and foster safer, drug-free communities. Outstanding work to everyone involved! 🇺🇸
 
#FURA #HSI #HSTFSanJuan #CBP #JIATFS #DrugInterdiction #MaritimeSecurity #PuertoRico #LawEnforcement #JointOperations #BorderSecurity
